LanguageData.RimDigital_ReceivedBonus.label: received a bonus
LanguageData.RimDigital_ReceivedBonus.description: The boss actually paid me a digital silver bonus today, and a decent one at that! Praise the colony, praise the boss! I'm going to buy something tasty!
LanguageData.RimDigital_Fined.label: funds confiscated
LanguageData.RimDigital_Fined.description: The digital silver I worked so hard to save was forcibly confiscated! This is plain robbery! I'm furious!
LanguageData.RimDigital_UnpaidWage.label: colony wage arrears
LanguageData.RimDigital_UnpaidWage.description: The boss can't even pay wages! My wallet is empty and I can barely afford my data plan! And they still expect me to work hard? Not a chance!
LanguageData.RimDigital_InterestYield.label: fund interest gained
LanguageData.RimDigital_InterestYield.description: Checked my digital wallet's fund today - interest went up again! Watching that digital silver number grow feels great!
LanguageData.RimDigital_Profit.label: stock profit
LanguageData.RimDigital_Profit.description: The stocks I bought went up today. Made quite a bit of digital silver! I'm basically the stock god!
LanguageData.RimDigital_Loss.label: stock loss
LanguageData.RimDigital_Loss.description: The stocks I bought dropped... lost quite a bit of digital silver. Never touching those again! (Next time for sure)
